| description = While fighting alongside [[Trakanon]] during the Ring of Scale Civil War, the mighty dragon Kodezal was mortally wounded by [[Phara Dar]]. In his final desperate moments, Kodezal called out to [[Cazic-Thule]] who responded by transforming Kodezal into an undead dragon of terrible power. Now, with his memories all but forgotten and in the form of a dracoliche, Kodezal serves Cazic-Thule as his second-in-command in the [[Plane of Fear]]. 

This towering skeletal dragon who breathes a flesh-rotting miasma is the second strongest critter in the [[Plane of Fear]].

Telin: Post-revamp dracoliche will no longer have a chance to drop pre-revamp loot.[https://project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=410915]

== Strategy ==

Engaging a dracoliche will '''not''' cause Cazic-Thule to agro if he is up. 

Procs the same 1500 HP life-tap as Venril Sathir, Trakanon, and Nortlav: [[Deadly Lifetap]]. Also has a relatively weak disease AOE. Does '''not''' enrage. Does '''not''' rampage.

It's recommended to have the tank use Evasive discipline reduce the proc rate of draco's lifetap. Using a slower two-handed weapon will also reduce the number of ripostes and potentially the number of procs as well. Draco won't proc at all when he hits a tank with [[Rune IV]] or similar damage absorbing spells.

Draco, like other skeletal dragon model NPCs, have unexpectedly small hitboxes. It's worth the effort to have enchanters, necromancers, and druids charm some pets as they will have less trouble putting dps into draco compared to melee dps class characters. Good charm pet candidates include [[Irak Altil]], [[A fetid fiend]]s, and [[A Shiverback]]s.

Somehow, not flagged as undead.
